title: ACE-Step 1.5 generates commercial-quality full songs in under two seconds on an A100
description:
You're paying Suno ten bucks a month when there's an open-source model that runs on your own GPU and sounds just as good? ACE-Step 1.5 generates commercial-quality full songs in under two seconds on an A100, under ten seconds on a 3090. Runs on 4GB VRAM minimum. Ten-minute songs, batch generation, 50 languages, covers, stem separation, metadata control for BPM and key. 

https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5

#github #opensource
